items.t: Gilead Brings HIV Prevention to the 27th Annual Latin GRAMMY Awards®
items.sum: FOSTER CITY, Calif., November 12, 2026--Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) today announced a new collaboration with TelevisaUnivision and the 27th Latin GRAMMY Awards that will bring HIV prevention awareness into one of the most prominent cultural moments for Latino audiences.

items.t: Gilead (GILD) Stock Still Looks Undervalued On Its 205% Run
items.sum: Gilead Sciences has ridden a powerful run in recent years, with the stock now trading near US$170.87, so the key question is whether that share price still matches what its cash flows can support. With major HIV and liver disease programs in the spotlight again, investors are increasingly asking how the company’s current valuation lines up against the cash the business can realistically generate.
